title: Club Earning Rates and Corporate Eligibility by Hotel Rate Plan
content:
What a stay earns towards the Wanderlane Traveller Club, and whether a plan may be sold at a corporate programme rate, are contracted plan by plan across the Hotel Rate Plans range.

| Rate plan | Points earned on the room total | Tier-qualifying multiplier | Corporate programme rate may be applied |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 0 percent | 0.0 | no |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 50 percent | 0.5 | no |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 75 percent | 1.0 | yes |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 100 percent | 1.0 | yes |
| Member Flex Rate | 150 percent | 1.5 | no |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 125 percent | 1.25 | yes |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 150 percent | 1.5 | no |

The first column is the percentage of the room total that accrues as traveller club points. The second is the multiplier applied to room spend when counting tier-qualifying points. The third records whether a corporate travel programme rate may be applied to the plan.

**Two readings.** By earning, the Member Flex Rate and the All-Inclusive Flex Rate stand highest at 150 percent with a multiplier of 1.5, and the Non-Refundable Saver Rate lowest at 0 percent with a multiplier of 0.0. By corporate eligibility the range divides differently: the Semi-Flexible Rate, the Standard Flexible Rate and the Suite Flexible Rate are eligible, the other four are not, so that the Member Flex Rate stands at the top of one column and outside the other.
